articles.summary: Net Interest Margin Expansion and Improved Efficiency Drive a 27% Increase in First Quarter Earnings The First Bancorp (Nasdaq: FNLC), ("the Company", "we", "us", "our"), parent company of First National Bank, today reported unaudited results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Net income for the period was $9.0 million with fully diluted earnings per share of $0.80, as compared to net income of $7.1 million and diluted earnings per share of $0.63 for the three months ended March 31, 2025. articles.title: The First Bancorp Announces First Quarter Results
